items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a guy named Steve Epstein, and the engineer, they start to talking about microphones.

ctx.x: You didn’t read your liner notes?

I read them back then, but I never really, I…. It’s his thing. It’s his thing. I didn’t really interfere with that, you know? He’s a good writer. He got his degree in creative writing from The University of New Orleans. And, I often did not agree with his a…. I didn’t agree

with his opinions, or his outcomes. But they are his liner notes, so I let him write them. [And, a…] It’s real funny how people were like coming at me. “Man, that shit Delfeayo wrote in the liner notes….” I said, “Talk to Delfeayo about it. I had nothing to do with it.” And, you know, I guess they thought that I was using Delfeayo as a voice pipe to say things I wanted to say. I said, “You know I’m a grown-ass man I can say it on my own. I don’t need Delfeayo to do that.” And a… you know, they were really…
